On Your First Turn, Skip that turn.
On Your Last Turn, take and Additional Turn after that.

CIRCLE_OF_LEECHES.desc:
After an ability of a Coin Piece you own is activated, Add a %s to it.
After a %s is removed from a Coin Piece you own, add a %s to it.
CIRCLE_OF_LEECHES.name: Circle of Leeches

CROWN_OF_PRIMAE_NOCTIS.desc: At the start of each Round, Choose an Opponent's Coin Piece and activate a Copy of its ability.

PRESERVER_OF_THE_DROWNED.desc: The first time each Round your Spin becomes less than 0, gain %d Spin.

TWIN_HEADED_OUROBOROS.desc:
On Your First Turn, when you activate an ability, Copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
On Your Last Turn, when you activate an ability, Counter it.
TWIN_HEADED_OUROBOROS.name: Twin-Headed Ouroboros

AQUA_FORTIS.desc: At the start of your turn, Lose %d Spin.
AQUA_FORTIS.name: Aqua Fortis Seal

CLEANSING.desc: At the end of your turn, remove this and all adjacent Seals.
CLEANSING.name: Cleansing Seal

COPPER.desc: At the end of your turn, if an ability of this Coin Piece was activated, Lose %d Spin and Remove this Seal. Otherwise, gain %d Spin.
COPPER.name: Copper Seal

LEAD.desc: The next time an ability of this Coin Piece would be activated, Counter that activation and Remove this Seal.
LEAD.name: Lead Seal

QUICKSILVER.desc: After an ability of this Coin Piece is activated, Lose %d Spin.
QUICKSILVER.name: Quicksilver Seal
